modelling_choice: KC-KC treated as non-excitatory (weights scaled by kc_kc_scale in a wrapper); real contacts mostly axo-axonic; modelling choice, not stated by the connectome
ci_method: mean +- t(0.975, df=3) x sample std / sqrt(4) over seeds 0-3; per seed, change_pct pools all hits of the voice
pass_rule: CI lower bound >= +20.0 % for kick and snare, and mean share of KCs active per sixteenth step < 20.0 %
